case_name: Amit Nath Saini & Ors vs State (Gov. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Amit Nath Saini, Maheshwari Nath Saini, Smt. Kamlesh, Smt. Himani Nath Saini and Sunil Kumar Soni — husband, wife, etc.
parties.respondent_defendant: State (Gov. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr — government, complainant

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.193/2012 registered under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860. Parties have arrived at a settlement and the marriage has been dissolved vide a decree of divorce through mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement arrived at between the parties can be a valid basis for quashing criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: She has also stated to the effect that there is no opposition to the quashing of the FIR and the consequential proceedings being quashed subject to the entire terms of the settlement being adhered to.

legal_principles.principle: A decree of divorce through mutual consent under Section 13 B (2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is a valid basis for granting divorce.
legal_principles.held: She has also stated that she had received a sum of Rs.25,00,000/- previously out of the stated settlement amount of Rs.35,00,000/- and vide a decree of divorce through mutual consent under Section 13 B (2) of the Hindu Marriage Act,1955 dated 25.11.2019 in HMA No.1787/2019 of the Court of the Judge, Family Court, Central District, Tis Hazari Court.

outcome.final_order: FIR No.193/2012 is quashed along with consequential proceedings, subject to the terms of the settlement being adhered to.
